picture-pairs.name: Pija me erũw
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Geim in Kaimeroñ Pija ñan Dementia: Pija me Erũw
picture-pairs.h1: Pija me Erũw: Geim in Kaimeroñ me Omwi
picture-pairs.description: Aia geim in kaimeroñ me mwiyen me omwi ñan engame me ro bwiema itũrũñ. Pija ro ebaubo ro ba maña, eab eor awa me skor, me kom kũ ñabwi 4 me rop 12 te pija.
picture-pairs.short: Metu pija me erũw me eñame. Pija ro kũ ba maña.
picture-pairs.intro: Tapun pija e, me e tapun pija me eñame bwe. Pija ro ba maña, bwe eab oboen me aea itũrũñ. Ña pija erũw eñame, eor raran goor ma mak in check.
howTo: Ñabwi ebaubwen pija me kom ogit bwi. Aia angō me 4 pija ebwaomwi bwe kom owaran.
Tapun gata pija. E tsimine raran goor.
Tapun pija me arin eñame. Pija me erũw ro eitũw ma mak in check.
Ña pija erũw eiyara, eab eor dudu me dogin. Tapun wagan ña kom memeg.
Katemoñ "Pija ro etuñ" ña kom erũw maro geim in aier ñwo.
tips: Ean iya pija ro me madaura iya: "Kapen ti me ebumoñ. Kom maro dairin iat ti um?"
Komaen amen kom aea bwe e tapun, arame e bwaran aea. Totowi me eab tapun bwe am kor.
Iyo pija 4 ña e omo am engame. Ebaubo pija e bwet am ñabwi, eab bwe kom eñame aen.
Aen ña e omo am engame. Geim ekaña e roñ me omo.

faq.q: E tsimine awa me skor?
faq.a: Eab. Eab eor kurok, skor, etan move me oten. Kom maro aen iat gata ao, me aen iat nũbwa e omo bwe roñ.

faq.q: Bwaran pija ro ro ba maña?
faq.a: Bwe pija ro ba maña, geim e eitũw aea ma kaimeroñ me eab oboen aea itũrũñ. Engame ro ebaubo aea e omwi. Kom maro kadudo pija ro etuñ iat tapun ekaña ña kom ogit.

faq.q: E mwiyen, me a oboen rejidur?
faq.a: Ee, e mwiyen, me eab eor akaunt, rejidur me download. E makur iat web browser iat fon, tablet me kompyuta.

faq.q: Kam maro aea pija in bwiema kor?
faq.a: Ee. Aea Photo pairs, me e komaen kom ñabwi pija ngen am devais. Pija ro ro ba iat browser me eab etu ngen internet.

find-the-same.name: Metu me eñame
find-the-same.seoTitle: Metu Pija me Eñame: Geim in Pija me Omwi ñan Dementia
find-the-same.description: Pija ekaña iat pouñ, erũw me rop aeañog iat emwak. Tapun pija me eñame. Geim in pija me mwiyen me omwi ñan engame me ro bwiema itũrũñ, eab eor awa.
find-the-same.short: Aea pija iat pouñ me tapun pija me eñame iat emwak.
find-the-same.intro: Pija ekaña e ba iat pouñ in skrin. Iat emwak e tsimine erũw, aiyiū me e aeañog pija. Tapun pija me eñame. E bwet ñabwi ekaña iat ao, me e tsimine ean me madaura.
howTo: Ñabwi erũw, aiyiū me e aeañog pija bwe kom ñabwi. Erũw e omwi kakarar.
Aea pija iat pouñ kom erũw.
Tapun pija me eñame iat emwak. E tsimine mak in check ma dorer in omo.
Ña e tapun pija me eiyara, geim e aen iya me e kikiñ. Eab kukur am ao.
Tapun "Pija nuka" ña kom memeg ñan pija epo.
tips: Madaura pija ro owaran kom ñabwi: kolor, anuan, iyat kom kũ aea.
Erũw ñabwi eab "ebarabwan". E bwet ao in omo, eab bwe kadur.
Ña tapun e mwejen, amen ro kũ totowi me kom tapun bwe am kor.

faq.q: E tsimine awa me skor?
faq.a: Eab. Eab eor kurok, skor, etan move me oten. Kom maro aen iat gata ao, me aen iat nũbwa e omo bwe roñ.

faq.q: Daga e bita ña e tapun pija me iyara?
faq.a: Eab eor dudu me dogin. Eab eor buzzer, raran cross me aeañeñ. Geim e aen iya pija me tapun me e kikiñ ñan tapun nuka.

faq.q: E mwiyen, me a oboen rejidur?
faq.a: Ee, e mwiyen, me eab eor akaunt, rejidur me download. E makur iat web browser iat fon, tablet me kompyuta.

shadow-match.name: Kaimeroñ anũan
shadow-match.seoTitle: Geim in Kaimeroñ Anũan ñan Dementia: Mwiyen Online
shadow-match.h1: Kaimeroñ Anũan: Geim in Pija me Omwi
shadow-match.description: Anũan me erũrũ iat pouñ, erũw me rop aeañog pija iat emwak. Tapun pija me e anũan e. Geim in anũan me mwiyen me omwi ñan dementia, eab eor awa.
shadow-match.short: Aea anũan me tapun pija me e anũan e.
shadow-match.intro: Kaimeroñ anũan e aia makur me engame ro omaro iat peba, me ngago e ba iat pija ebaubo me eab ogit print. Anũan me omwi e ba iat pouñ in skrin me erũw, aiyiū me aeañog pija iat emwak. Tapun pija me e anũan e. Pija ro ngen baasiko, ambrera me kapen ti e omo iya madaura.
howTo: Ñabwi erũw, aiyiū me e aeañog pija bwe kom ñabwi. Erũw e omwi kakarar.
Aea anũan kom erũw. E bita arin? E ikũk me e momok?
Tapun pija me e anũan e. Iyin e ba iat emwak in anũan.
Ña e tapun pija me eiyara, geim e aen iya me e kikiñ. Eab kukur am ao.
Tapun "Anũan nuka" ña kom memeg ñan anũan epo.
tips: Towi reben anũan ma baim me madaura arin.
Ña anũan e mwejen ngago, kadudo ngen Metu me eñame, bwe pija ro ro eñame arin.
Madaura pija ña e metu: "Kam tsimine ambrera ngen ñwo omo."

faq.q: E tsimine awa me skor?
faq.a: Eab. Eab eor kurok, skor, etan move me oten. Kom maro aen iat gata ao, me aen iat nũbwa e omo bwe roñ.

faq.q: E omo ke shadow matching bwo engame ngago re mwaer inebin?
faq.a: E kona ngeni makur ngea e mwamweiy me e omo bwo engame nanga, baji kor ian ngago e kereri. E mwamweiy amin aea pija pumwe dorer. E bita bwo amin maruwei me dorer, eab tes, me eab dober me eab ekog mwaerin ineb. Ngago e kowawa, wo kona aea Find the same me ougoda aea pija ituga.

faq.q: Meda e gona ngago wo tepenia pija ngea e se bita?
faq.a: Eko meto e kowawa. Eko basa, koros e ebara me eko mwiwi. Gem e ougen egün pija ngea wo tepenia me e ropu bwo tep nanga.

faq.q: E firi ke, me a bo amin sain-ap?
faq.a: Eh, e firi, me eko akaun, sain-ap me daunlod. E makur ian web browser ian fon, tebret me kompiuta.

sort-together.name: Aetan ituga
sort-together.seoTitle: Gem in Aetan bwo Engame ngago re Mwaer Inebin: Sort Together
sort-together.h1: Sort Together: Makur in Aetan Pija
sort-together.description: Tepenia pija, me tepenia ebwer ngea e bwiida ian: kisin me gadun, wuan eto me man. Bita makur in aetan e mwamweiy me e firi bwo engame ngago re mwaer inebin.
sort-together.short: Aetan iturin pija ian eben ebwer: kisin me gadun, me meto nanga.
sort-together.intro: Aetan meto bita makur ngea e mwamweiy me roke iat eb, erier animwen aetan katen ian stua me aetan soks. Tepenia pija, me tepenia ebwer ngea e bwiida ian. Eko rupe me eko meto e se bita.
howTo: Ita theme: kisin me gadun, wuan eto me man, me mwenge me fofori.
Tepenia pija. E bwida an gold border.
Tepenia ebwer ngea e bwiida ian. Pija e nuwaw ian bita ebwer.
Ngago e bwiida ian bita ebwer nanga, gem e dorer ian omo me e ropu.
Ngago e modin aetan pija, aea ian eben ebwer ituga.
tips: Iat eb e tsimine bita eko wrong answer. Ngago amen omera e dorer bita watering can e bwiida ian kisin, kiowen dorer bwo meda. Wo kona orre karani dorer e omo.
Kukuni pija bwo dorer: "Meda wo aruma ian am gadun?"
Aetan meto iat eb, erier spun me fok me baten ian karor, bita makur e omo ngago wo eab aea skrin.

faq.q: E tsimine ke taima me skoa?
faq.a: Eab. Eko kurok, skoa, namban move me eko edae. Wo kona teki ian ga ean, me teki ian nukon e omo kor bwo amin modin.

faq.q: Bwo meda aetan?
faq.a: Engame e baji re maruwei aetan bwo erier makur e omo me re roke. E mwamweiy ngeni amin kakairũ bwo pija ngago wo makur.

faq.q: E firi ke, me a bo amin sain-ap?
faq.a: Eh, e firi, me eko akaun, sain-ap me daunlod. E makur ian web browser ian fon, tebret me kompiuta.

picture-puzzle.name: Pija pasro
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Jigsaw Puzzle e Mwamweiy bwo Engame ngago re Mwaer Inebin: 4 me 9 Pieces
picture-puzzle.description: Jigsaw e mwamweiy ian onlain bwo engame ngago re mwaer inebin: 4 me 9 pieces e kowawa, pija e modin e pwerin aea, me wo tepenia aro piece bwo amin ibiwi.
picture-puzzle.short: Tepenia aro piece bwo amin ibiwi me pija e bwiida.
picture-puzzle.intro: Pija e omo e kateki ian 4 me 9 pieces e kowawa me e kakore. Pija e modin e pwerin aea bwo aeaen. Tepenia a piece, me tepenia nanga, me re ibiwi eben. Eko doren dragging.
howTo: Ita pija me 4 me 9 pieces. 4 e omo bwo kererin.
Aea pija e modin ian pwon.
Tepenia piece, me tepenia eb ngea e bwiida ian. Aro piece re ibiwi.
Pieces ngago e bwiida ian eben re orre check mark e eowur.
Ngago pija e modin, maruwei ituga, me ita pija nanga.
tips: Tepenia aro piece bwo amin ibiwi e mwamweiy kor pumwe dragging bwo engame e baji.
Dorer bwo pija ngago e bwiida: "Ngea bita red roof."
Jigsaw in debao iat eb me 12 me 24 pieces e kowawa bita makur ian tebo e omo kor.

faq.q: E tsimine ke taima me skoa?
faq.a: Eab. Eko kurok, skoa, namban move me eko edae. Wo kona teki ian ga ean, me teki ian nukon e omo kor bwo amin modin.

faq.q: A bo ke amin drag pieces?
faq.a: Eab. Tepenia a piece, me tepenia nanga, me re ibiwi eben. E mwamweiy ngago e mwiwi be me ian skrin e eowur.

faq.q: E firi ke, me a bo amin sain-ap?
faq.a: Eh, e firi, me eko akaun, sain-ap me daunlod. E makur ian web browser ian fon, tebret me kompiuta.

finish-the-saying.name: Modin dorer
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Finish the Saying: Gem in Dorerin Eraro bwo Riring
finish-the-saying.description: Dorerin eraro me ngago me Amerika ngago e mwaer dorer ian aeaen, erier "A penny saved is a penny ___". Tepenia dorer me aea bita modin, me dorer bwo meto nanga.
finish-the-saying.short: Kamodin dorerin eraro ituga, me kakairũ bwo meto nanga.
finish-the-saying.intro: Dorerin ngago re roke iat eb. Katen e aea dorerin eraro me dorer ian aeaen e mwaer, aiji choices, me baten in "Show the ending". Ngago e aea modin, dorer in kiowen e omo bwo amin kakairũ.
howTo: Aea dorer ian ituga.
Tepenia dorer ngea e kamodin, me tepenia "Show the ending".
Aea dorer e modin bwo amin kakairũ.
Tepenia "Next saying" ngago wo bo.
tips: Aea ian mwamwein me ropu iat dorer ian aeaen. Engame re dorer ngago wo eita modin.
Ngago amen omera e dorer modin nanga, maruwei. Dorerin eraro nanga e bwiida ian mwenge me eb nanga.
Ian koro engame, eman e aea me engame modin re dorer modin.

faq.q: E tsimine ke taima me skoa?
faq.a: Eab. Eke kurok, mak, an wounen nane me erum. O bwiida ian ngago me ngago, me an bwiida ian ubun e magitet an erieri.

faq.q: Me ekeita me da aen dorer me ijei?
faq.a: Aitsiu e aen ijei an erieri me e tsimor dorer. Eke mak, me iwonen an me ijei e omo.

faq.q: E maagur eij, me e magu a an tsiedida?
faq.a: Io, e maagur, me eke akaun, eke tsiedida me eke daunrood. E mwir ian web browser ian tepon, tablet me kompiuta.

word-search.name: Tsimor dorer iwonen etong
word-search.seoTitle: Tsimor Dorer Iwonen Etong ñan Dementia, Bwio Ian Bwapepa
word-search.description: Tsimor dorer iwonen etong maagur ñan engame ririd me engame ñaga etsimor me dementia. Eke ebwak dorer, etong reta, dorer e rir me e ebwio. Tsimor online me bwio ian bwapepa.
word-search.short: Etong reta, eke ebwak dorer, rir me ebwio. Bwio ian bwapepa tsin.
word-search.intro: Grid ekeking me reta etong me eke ebwak dorer, rir me ebwio. Tsinita te reta an ebwa ian dorer, me tsinita an erieri reta. O gobweda bwapepa? Bwio eke aitsiu ian aiquen tsinita.
howTo: Aen tema me ekeida grid.
Aea list in dorer. Dorer e rir (meo ñan atag) me e ebwio (pwer me ijad).
Tsinita te reta an ebwa ian dorer, me tsinita an erieri reta.
Dorer ngago o arowa e kakar me e omar ian list.
Tsinita "Bwio aitsiu" bwe o tsimor ian bwapepa me pensir me maka.
tips: Doreda dorer ian list me irowida reta an ebwa nanga.
Ian bwapepa, highlighter e mwir an koro me pensir.
Dorer katsimor tema in dorer. Dorer in wani e katsimor aea in bwer, kok me maket.

faq.q: E tsimor kurok me mak?
faq.a: Eab. Eke kurok, mak, an wounen nane me erum. O bwiida ian ngago me ngago, me an bwiida ian ubun e magitet an erieri.

faq.q: A ngab bwio tsimor dorer?
faq.a: Io. Tsinita "Bwio aitsiu" bwe o bwio grid ian reta etong, me list in dorer e pwer. Tsimor dorer me eke tsimor e bwiida me ijei.

faq.q: E maagur eij, me e magu a an tsiedida?
faq.a: Io, e maagur, me eke akaun, eke tsiedida me eke daunrood. E mwir ian web browser ian tepon, tablet me kompiuta.

coloring.name: Bwapepa in kakar
coloring.seoTitle: Bwapepa in Kakar ñan Engame Ririd me Dementia (Maagur)
coloring.description: Bwapepa in kakar ekeking ñan engame ririd me etong tsi: tsinita kala, me tsinita aitsiu. Eke buoita, eke kala me ijei, me aiquen bwapepa e maagur an bwio.
coloring.short: Tsinita kala, me tsinita aitsiu. Bwio bwapepa tsin.
coloring.intro: Bwapepa me etong tsi ekeking: dugidu ian pod, ebwa, tiikap, bepe me eangan. Tsinita kala, me tsinita aitsiu bwe o kakar. Eke kala me erum.
howTo: Aen bwapepa.
Tsinita kala. Aiquen kala e torea etam.
Tsinita aitsiu bwe o omodida me kala.
O mwir an wounen ngago me ngago ian an kakar ijei.
Tsinita "Bwio aitsiu" bwe o arowa bwapepa kakar me pensir me maka.
tips: Aean erogo kala bwe en aen me eke magitet aen amuro.
Dabugbug iwonen karoro me puji iwonen edag e omo. Aitsiu e katsimor kakar, me eke katsimor an bwiida.
Bwapepa ngago o bwio e omo me maka etong me crayons, bwe e mwir an koro.

faq.q: E tsimor kurok me mak?
faq.a: Eab. Eke kurok, mak, an wounen nane me erum. O bwiida ian ngago me ngago, me an bwiida ian ubun e magitet an erieri.

faq.q: Bwapepa aitsiu e arorong in emwidr?
faq.a: Amo kakar etokwog ekeking me eke cartoons, bwe bwapepa e omo ñan engame ririd. Etong tsi e mwir an kakar me eke arorong in emwidr.

faq.q: E maagur eij, me e magu a an tsiedida?
faq.a: Io, e maagur, me eke akaun, eke tsiedida me eke daunrood. E mwir ian web browser ian tepon, tablet me kompiuta.

conversation-cards.name: Kaat in dorer
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Katsimor Dorer ñan Dementia: Kaat in Aitsiu
conversation-cards.description: Kaat in aitsiu me dorer katsimor ñan engame ñaga etsimor me dementia: eke kuits, eke dorer me e omo. Tsimor ian screen me bwio kaat amuro.
conversation-cards.short: Kaat in aitsiu me eke kuits. Katsimor dorer.
conversation-cards.intro: Aiquen kaat e torea aitsiu me katsimor dorer, bwe "Meda ebwa in ean ngago o gobweda?" Eke dorer me erum me eke memori. Aen tema me amwirida amuro.
howTo: Aen tema, me koro "Kaat amuro".
Aea dorer me aea aitsiu nanga.
Rongerong, katsimor dorer imwim, me koro dorer an mwir.
Tsinita "Kaat me ijei" ngago o gobweda, me o bwiida ian kaat ngago o gobweda.
Tsinita "Bwio kaat amuro" bwe o koto bwapepa.
tips: Doreda dorer imwim tsin. E arorong in dorer, me eke intabyu.
Koro dorer in aitsiu, me eke facts. E omo me details e wounen.
Me kaat e katsimor dorer in kakar, aea an arorong me ean kaat me ijei.

faq.q: Ekeita me eke dorer in "O nuwawida…"?
faq.a: Dorer ngago o kuits memori e arorong in eksam me e kakar. Katsimor dorer bwe "Katsimor dorer in…" e koro aiquen engame an dorer, ian ngago me ngago.

faq.q: A ngab bwio kaat?
faq.a: Io. "Bwio kaat amuro" e bwio kaat amuro ian reta etong, ebwak kaat ian aiquen bwapepa, bwe o koto.

faq.q: E maagur eij, me e magu a an tsiedida?
faq.a: E, e pumwe eab, me eke akaun, registe me eab iwiid. E mwitwen nane browser ate terepon, tabret me kompiuta.

photo-pairs.name: Pija me pairin
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Mwakani geim in pair pija ian pija ngen fämili
photo-pairs.description: Kadurow pija ngen fämili bwe geim in pair e maron me kamie. Kidä 2 ngari 6 pija nane dän ngam; e mimin ian browser ngam me eab upload nane ebwak.
photo-pairs.short: Kidä pija ngam me kadurow. Eke tsimurin e upload.
photo-pairs.intro: Kidä eron 2 ngari 6 pija nane terepon, tabret me kompiuta ngam, me erang geim in pair e obo pija e katsin me aea e mwitwen. Pija kai e mimin ian tei peij. Eab upload, eab sev me eab share, me e gog ian peij e kakat.
howTo: Tap "Choose photos" me kidä 2 ngari 6 pija.
Ewon pija e obo erua. Tap pija ewon, me tap te pairin.
Dorer pija ewon ngage amuro aea.
Ngage amuro amaro, kakat peij me tap "Clear photos". Eke pija e koto.
tips: Kidä pija e katsin ngen kiki e oaten me kabori: pet, garden, te ebwak e oaten, me ran in kabubwiya.
Pija ngen te ebwak me kiki e maron e katsin ngen pija in ewa, me eab aijebur engame bwe ro nemin engame.
Dowa pija ngen engame ro ama ngage e bita atumor, aea e bita kamo ngage ro oaten.

faq.q: Pija ngak e upload nane ebwak?
faq.a: Eab. Tei peij e aea pija nane browser ngam me obo ate skrin ngam. Eab owara ngen awo me ebwak engame, me e gog ngage amuro kakat me reload peij.

faq.q: E tsimurin taima me sko?
faq.a: Eab. Eke taima, sko, count in mwitwen me eke luus. Amuro maron bwiok ate te taim e oaten, me bwiok ate dabora e katsin me mwitwen bwe amaro.

faq.q: Ang maron sev geim bwe ngen taim in mwin?
faq.a: Eab ian browser, bwe pija e praivet me eab sev. Ap in pumwe eab Golden Moments ngen iPhone me iPad maron sev kopii in pija nane dän ngam.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo in pija
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Picture Bingo ngen amen korobub me amen memori kabori: Maron print
picture-bingo.description: Pumwe eab print bingo in pija ngen memory care me krup in amen korobub, me obo caller e katsin ate skrin. Pija e katsin me dorer, 9 ngari 16 skwea, eke aea dorer e bo.
picture-bingo.short: Kat in bingo in pija maron print me caller ate skrin ngen krup.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo e katsin ngen pija, eke namba, bwe eke engame e bo bwe aea dorer e riek. Print kat e ibuk, me arowa caller ate skrin bwe obo pija e katsin ate TV, laptop me tabret.
howTo: Kidä 9 ngari 16 skwea ate kat me ian ewo engame ro mwitwen.
Tap "Print cards". Kat ewon e ibuk.
Kaara caller ate skrin e katsin. Tap "Next picture" bwe obo pija ewon me etan.
Engame ro tabwe pija e kadurow ate kat ngen koen, baten me maka.
Engame ewon ro amaro lain, ngari kat e bita, ro oaten. Eke luus ian geim tei: mwitwen ngang engame ewon ro bita lain.
tips: Arowa tokin e katsin ngen botor kap me checkers. Baten e riek e maron kabori ngen kiid.
Etan pija me dorer kiki ngen pija: "Bout in anio. Nga e ibwid ate bout?"
Teko engame ro kabori ngen aea arowa skrin, me kadurow amen aroweda ngen engame ro bo ia.
9 skwea e mwitwen ngen bita krup. Arowa 20 ngari 30 minit bwe mwitwen.

faq.q: Awo maron arowa picture bingo ian care home?
faq.a: Print kat ewon ngen engame ewon, arowa caller ate skrin e katsin, me etan pija e maron me kadok. Mwitwen ngang engame ewon ro bita lain, bwe eke engame e dowa.

faq.q: E pumwe eab ngen print?
faq.a: E. Print kat ewon amuro oaten, ewon taim, ngen engame ngam ngari krup.

faq.q: Engame maron mwitwen ngage eab aea dorer?
faq.a: E. Skwea ewon e pija e katsin, me etan e mimin ian eton ngen engame ro oaten aea dorer.

calm-breathing.name: Eamwir e katsin
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Taim in eamwir e katsin ngen amen korobub me amen aroweda
calm-breathing.description: Taim in eamwir e maron me katsin ngen share: sakor e tubwa me e riek ngen 6 eamwir. Amuro kaara, me amuro maron bwiok ate te taim amuro oaten.
calm-breathing.short: Sakor e maron ngen eamwir ian arowen. Kaara me bwiok ngage amuro oaten.
calm-breathing.intro: Taim ewon mwitwen e katsin e bwiok e maron. Tap "Start", me eamwir ian sakor e tubwa me eamwir eow ngage e riek. Kidä e maron ngari e katsin. Eke medesin, e taim in katsin ngen share.
howTo: Tekateki e katsin ian arowen me arowen.
Kidä taim: e maron ngari e katsin.
Tap "Start". Eamwir ian sakor e tubwa, me eamwir eow ngage e riek.
E bwiok ewon ngage 6 eamwir e bita, ngari tap "Stop" ate te taim amuro oaten.
tips: Kiid pein ngari dowa pei ate pae ngen amen ngam ngage e oaten.
Eke kae. Ngage ro oaten aea, e katsin.
Ngage engame e kabori ngen eamwir, eamwir ngen kiki me aea sakor. Dorer ngen dokta ngage e tsimurin kabori ngen eamwir.

faq.q: Tei e ekises in medesin ngen eamwir?
faq.a: Eab. E taim e maron ngen katsin me mimin ian arowen. Eke medesin ngen anxiety ngari te bita kabori. Dorer ngen dokta ngen kiki in bwiema.

faq.q: Sakor e mwitwen ngage ang eab kaara?
faq.a: Deõ. Eko imin nimwemwe ñaga eitsiõk wo tap Start, me e katoki mwurin 6 ònano eke ngaga wo tap Stop. Ña device om e set bwe e reduce motion, dorer nan tsientji me eab eba circle.

faq.q: E free ñe, me a bita sign up?
faq.a: Eh, e free, me eko account, sign-up eke download. E makur eat web browser eat phone, tablet eke computer.
